organism.fractal_suture_note: Catalogue value for this slot (D_f = 1.55). The vendored photograph shows the ribbed exterior, not an exposed suture, so D_f is not remeasured on these pixels.

phenomenon_scale.label: 24 µm
phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Dactylioceras commune (24 µm, detail scale)

paleobiology.chronoseries_note: This binomial has a single campaign time point (181 Ma). The predecessor and successor used for the scale comparison are the lineage neighbors, not additional Dactylioceras chronospecies.
paleobiology.what_changes_at_this_scale: The detail-scale critical wavelength is held at 2.419e-05 m (24.19 µm). What changes from Ceratites (240 Ma) through Dactylioceras (181 Ma) to Placenticeras (75 Ma) is how many of those critical wavelengths fit across one organ-scale pigment/rib interval, plus the Whitby fibulation (outer-flank rib bifurcation) and the assigned suture dimension D_f = 1.55. This slot does not reuse the 1.5 mm organ-scale sibling's diffusion coefficients.

governing_model.name: Schnakenberg activator-inhibitor

equations.activator: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + a - u + u^2 v
equations.inhibitor: dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + b - u^2 v
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = largest eigenvalue of J - k^2 diag(Du, Dv)

parameters.note: Du and Dv are solved so that the textbook k_c formula returns exactly 2.419e-05 m. The ratio 7.2 sits just above the Schnakenberg onset ratio for these kinetics, so the most unstable wavelength remains within a few percent of lambda_c.

governing_model.boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries on the detail-scale periostracal patch used for the dispersion probe and the 2D stripe snapshot. The whole-shell growth animation uses a logarithmic accretion mask on the vendored Whitby photograph; it is not a periodic domain.

empirical_claims: Turing 1952: a reacting-diffusing pair can be stable without diffusion and unstable at a finite critical wavenumber k_c.
Schnakenberg 1979: the two-species system a - u + u^2 v, b - u^2 v has a limit-cycle-capable Jacobian that supports diffusion-driven instability when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster.
Meinhardt and Klingler 1987 and Fowler, Meinhardt and Prusinkiewicz 1992: molluscan shell pigment travels as a one-dimensional activator-inhibitor pattern laid down at the growing aperture.
Garcia-Ruiz, Checa and Rivas 1990: ammonitic septal sutures are a morphogenetic pattern, not a passive geometric ornament.
Lutz and Boyajian 1995: ammonoid suture traces have measurable fractal dimensions.
This slot assigns D_f = 1.55 to Dactylioceras commune and the detail wavelength 2.419e-05 m at 181 Ma. Those two numbers are catalogue inputs, not new measurements on the photograph.

specimen.notes: Slightly pyritized. The 57 mm width is the photographer's measurement and is the scale used to convert pixel rib spacing into millimetres.
